summary: A heat pump can very likely heat this house with the existing heating system at <= 55 C.

reasons.text: Two-pipe system: all radiators get water at the same temperature.
79-92 W/m2 is above 75 W/m2: better windows or insulation may be worth it.

technician_checks: Outdoor unit placement, sound and permits
assumptions: Partially renovated, built before 1979: 80-120 W/m2 (no official row for 'partially')
Full-load hours 1800-2100 h (official approx. 2,000; range ours)
Radiator rating scaled by face area from 600 x 1000 mm (rough)
Radiator output vs temperature: EN 442, n = 1.3, 10 K spread
Heat pump also covers hot water, at the same JAZ as space heating
